summary: Nine vehicles (6 on CR 297 along Pomeroy Creek, 1 Jeep and 2 motorcycles on CR 295 near Hancock Pass) stranded above St. Elmo after rapid snowmelt flash flooding washed out high-country roads; CCSAR-N, fire district, sheriff's deputies and USFS guided all vehicles out across the old DSP&P railroad bridge by 10:30 p.m., no injuries
location: St. Elmo; CR 297 along Pomeroy Creek; CR 295 near Hancock Pass
responding_agency: Chaffee County Search and Rescue North; Chaffee County Fire Protection District; Chaffee County Sheriff's Office; U.S. Forest Service
notes: Occupant count unstated; recorded as 1 per vehicle-stranding convention. 15-18 ft of low road washed away on CR 297; rescuers used the intact former Denver South Park & Pacific railroad bridge (closed to regular traffic) to cross the gulch. Chalk Creek gauge at Nathrop peaked at 1,208 cfs mid-morning Sunday 2023-05-28. Date pinned: incident Saturday ~5:30 p.m.; article metadata ~2023-05-28; 2023-05-27 was a Saturday.
